# Manuscript-ready tables generated by this package

## Table: Direct runtime comparison
Use `results/performance/timing_summary.csv`.
Columns recommended: Method, Type, Resolution, Median encryption time, Median decryption time, Median throughput.

## Table: BGPSE-IoT stage-wise runtime
Use `bgpse_stage_timing_summary.csv` and `bgpse_decrypt_stage_timing_summary.csv`.
Report ECDH, HKDF, content digest, GFSR seed hierarchy, dynamic S-box, permutation, mask generation, substitution, forward/reverse diffusion, AES-GCM, HMAC, and ECDSA.

## Table: Ablation timing
Use `bgpse_ablation_summary.csv`.
Report full BGPSE-IoT and changes produced by static S-box, SHAKE-only seed generation, no permutation, single diffusion, no outer AEAD, and no provenance signature.

## Statistical comparison
Use `timing_statistical_tests.csv`. Report Friedman p-values and Holm-corrected paired Wilcoxon tests. `median_ratio` is a performance ratio, not an effect size.
